decision: User explicitly requested removal of 2FA from every CaseLink account, including administrators. Provider operator MFA is unchanged.
implementation: Removed enrollment/challenge/factor-management screens and MFA-only recovery jobs.
Existing verification bookmarks redirect to the protected Families page.
Removed only second-factor requirements from application and database guards; kept password AMR, active accounts, current unexpired sessions, database roles and family permissions.
Migration stops if verified factors remain; it never deletes Auth credentials or historical audit events.
Local and hosted staging TOTP enrollment/verification disabled; only the unfinished staging factor removed.

tests.before: New password-only administrator unit regression failed with MfaRequiredError.
tests.after: All 682 tests across 81 files pass, including 27 focused account/session/form checks.
tests.databaseAndBrowser: Full CI 38652161517 and CodeQL 38652161611 passed on 323314ceffa43d69564bd7e5a886c62e209043b5, including actual Auth, RLS, restore, legacy upgrade and browser checks.

review: Normal correctness/security/privacy/accessibility/regression review plus Ponytail deletion and React review: existing auth and authorization paths preserved, dead MFA components/jobs removed, no replacement auth framework or dependency.
status: Staging password-only access verified. Hosted workflow found a separate profile date hydration defect; fix and candidate verification tracked under CL-08. Production release remains pending.

hosted.production: No existing factors. Public signup disabled and password policy strengthened. Full schema/application release still pending.
